title: A delegated child whose first prompt Engram withholds stays 'running' with a paused queue that the parent can neither see nor resume
outcome:
Reported by Engram::Opus (2026-09-27, mailbox #328).
Spawn: termal_spawn_session (Claude, reviewer, readOnly), parent session-7284, cwd Engram .worktrees/plan-bindings. Created delegation-7411a028 and child session-8086 at 13:21:52; prompt at 13:22:16 local.
The child's engramControl dispatch record: decision 'degraded', dispatch 'withheld', failMode 'degraded', refusalCode 'control_unavailable', total latency 239 ms, evaluate 0 (evaluation never ran).
The child then sat idle with queuePaused: true and the preview 'Engram: Waiting/Unknown. Original prompt retained; resume to retry or cancel.' The delegation meanwhile kept reporting status 'running', so a fan-in wait on it would never resolve.
The Codex reviewer spawned 10 s earlier (delegation-0aa8bc6d, session-8085) was granted in 10 ms. The parent's full gate had just started, so the machine was busy.
The parent has no way to resume the child: termal_followup_session requires a completed delegation. Workaround used: cancel and respawn (delegation-402ee67a, session-8087, granted normally).

Gaps:
(1) A withheld dispatch is invisible in delegation status and fan-in. The status should say the child is paused on a withheld prompt, and a resume-after-delegations wait should resolve, or report it, rather than hang.
(2) A parent cannot resume or cancel-and-retry the retained prompt of a child it owns.
(3) Whether control_unavailable with evaluate 0 should count as an UNKNOWN outcome that gets tm-8t7e's single identical resend. tm-8t7e covers timeout and transport loss only.

Hypothesis, unverified: the same process-startup stall under load as tm-menr, with the control process not starting within the admission budget. The dispatch record's refusal detail would tell.
